He gestures with a black pen in his right hand while speaking directly to the camera. The background is a static video game scene from Animal Crossing, showing a lush farm with orange pumpkins and wooden fences under bright, even lighting. (2) The frame cuts to include a large graphic overlay of white mathematical formulas and complex geometric diagrams on a solid dark purple background. The man's upper body remains visible at the bottom of the frame, continuing his explanations with active hand movements. The game background is partially obscured by the large informational symbols. (3) The visual returns to the full presenter view in front of the game farm. The character in the background game, a small white-clad avatar, is stationary near the pumpkin patch. The man looks directly at the camera, his facial expressions matching his speech, emphasizing points with the pen and palm gestures. (4) A technical flowchart appears, detailing the AlphaProof training system with blue and white nodes connected by arrows. The man is still visible at the bottom, pointing towards the diagram. The scene then transitions to a bar chart comparing AI performance against human competitors in mathematical competitions using various colored bars. (5) The final phase shows the man in a close-up shot, leaning slightly forward. He smiles and gestures broadly with both hands as he delivers what appears to be a concluding anecdote or riddle. The Animal Crossing background remains visible behind him, and the large text slogans at the top of the frame persist.
